title: One Long Road Home
synopsis: At a gentle park picnic, familiar neighbors find their places on the newly installed map. Jack revisits his notebook of earlier projects and Rex returns home by the same road that joins his friends.
continuity_state: Before: Mr. Lee's crew has completed the covered picture board beside Pine Park gate, showing locations, solid vehicle-road lines, dotted walking paths, the brook and Little Bridge. No unfinished construction or delivery remains. After: Familiar adult neighbors from the parcel shed, garage, firehouse, gravel yard and farm have enjoyed a small picnic at Pine Park. The new map remains at the gate, all prior vehicles and places retain their roles, the puppies return to their own homes, and Jack adds one new board drawing to his original blue notebook. The eleven-season arc closes gently while the world remains open for more stories.
